name: TC-906: the choices made on an item inside a deal (a paid size, a nested free sauce under it, a free dip) and the note on it are sent in the /quote and stored on the paid order — the deal upcharge is unchanged
description: Wings + fries @ $14. In the deal builder the wings are customised: Size '20 PC' (+$4.99, ADJUSTS_PRICE), then 'Buffalo' in the nested Wing Sauce group that 20 PC opens, then the free 'Ranch Dip', and a note in the item sheet's Special Instructions box (template-wind #143). The checkout's /quote body must carry orderDeals[0].items[<wings>].selectedModifiers with all three modifierIds, Buffalo's parentModifierId = 20 PC, and specialInstructions = the note; the server prices the deal at upcharge 4.99 / lineTotal 18.99 (pricing unchanged). Paid with the Stripe test card, the owner read (GET /api/order/:id) must show orderDealItems[<wings>].selectedModifiers naming all three, Buffalo with its parentModifierId, and specialInstructions = the note. Fails on QA until template-wind #143 (the note box — until then the box is not found), the template-wind deal-item-modifiers fix and the backend deal-item fixes deploy.
